# MIUI
> Xiaomi’s Android-based operating system, featuring MIUI 14 updates, privacy features, personalization, and cross-device connectivity.

MIUI on miui.com presents Xiaomi’s operating system experience, with product overview pages, version history, and links to related Xiaomi ecosystem services such as privacy, accessibility, cloud services, community, and the Xiaomi store.

## Main Pages
- [MIUI Home](https://www.miui.com/): Main MIUI landing page with navigation to MIUI features and Xiaomi ecosystem services.
- [MIUI 14](https://www.miui.com/14): Overview of MIUI 14 features, design updates, privacy, and interconnectivity capabilities.

## MIUI 14 Features
- [Lightweight and Smooth](https://www.miui.com/14): Highlights performance, reduced system footprint, and smoother everyday operation.
- [Personalized Visuals](https://www.miui.com/14): Covers visual customization, interface styling, and user-facing design improvements.
- [On-device Privacy](https://www.miui.com/14): Describes privacy protections and local processing features for user data security.
- [Interconnectivity](https://www.miui.com/14): Introduces device-to-device connectivity and Xiaomi ecosystem integration features.

## Version History
- [MIUI Review](https://www.miui.com/14): Timeline section summarizing the evolution of MIUI across major releases.
- [MIUI V1](https://www.miui.com/14): First MIUI release, dated 2010-08-16 in the MIUI 14 retrospective.
- [MIUI V2](https://www.miui.com/14): Second major MIUI version, dated 2010-10-29 in the version history.
- [MIUI V3](https://www.miui.com/14): Third major MIUI version, dated 2011-03-25 in the version history.
- [MIUI V4](https://www.miui.com/14): Fourth major MIUI version, dated 2012-01-19 in the version history.
- [MIUI V5](https://www.miui.com/14): Fifth major MIUI version, dated 2013-03-01 in the version history.

## Privacy and Accessibility
- [Xiaomi Privacy Center](https://privacy.hyperos.mi.com/): Privacy information and policies for Xiaomi software and connected services.
- [Xiaomi Accessibility](https://accessibility.mi.com/): Accessibility resources and support information for Xiaomi products and services.

## Xiaomi Ecosystem Services
- [Xiaomi Community](https://www.xiaomi.cn/): Official Xiaomi community site for discussions, announcements, and user engagement.
- [Xiaomi Cloud Services](https://i.mi.com/): Xiaomi account cloud platform for sync, backup, and device-related services.
- [Xiaomi Store](https://www.mi.com/): Official Xiaomi storefront for phones, smart devices, and ecosystem products.

## Related Xiaomi Platforms
- [Xiaomi Main Site](https://www.mi.com/): Corporate and product portal for Xiaomi hardware and consumer offerings.
- [Xiaomi Account Cloud](https://i.mi.com/): Account-linked cloud services supporting Xiaomi devices and user data management.
- [Xiaomi Community Portal](https://www.xiaomi.cn/): Community hub for Xiaomi users, announcements, and ecosystem participation.
